_comment: Every recording the game can use. Read by tools/install_sounds.py and tools/sound-list.mjs. 'file' is the name to give the generated file.

signature.name: The 3:17 toll
signature.where: On a siege night, when the clock reaches 3:17 and the last wave comes. Everyone hears it.
signature.prompt: A single huge bronze church bell tolling once, very low and slow, heard from far across a valley at night. The strike is soft and dull rather than sharp, followed by a long dark resonant decay with a slightly sour, detuned shimmer that wavers as it fades. Faint cold wind underneath. No melody, no other instruments, no voices. Ends in silence.

signature.name: The siege horn
signature.where: When a siege night begins. Everyone hears it.
signature.prompt: A deep war horn made of animal horn, blown once from a distant hillside at dusk: one long low note that swells, bends slightly downward at the end and dies away, with a natural outdoor echo off stone walls. A second, fainter horn answers from farther away. Breathy, rough, human-blown, medieval. No drums, no music, no voices.

signature.name: The choir hum (the singing)
signature.where: Faint on siege nights, louder near thin places and the Gate, always in the Hollow, beside a hidden Returned, full in a Slip. The game replays it every 5 seconds so the fades overlap into one endless note.
signature.prompt: A small choir of men and women holding one single low note (around D3) on a closed 'oo' vowel. No words, no melody, no vibrato, completely steady, as if heard through a thick stone wall. Slightly flat and breathy, calm rather than threatening. Dry, no reverb tail, the same volume from start to end.
signature.note: Ask for 15 seconds or more; the installer cuts the steadiest 7 seconds from the middle and fades both ends. A placeholder made in code is installed today.

signature.name: The Rift opening
signature.where: When the crack in the cave tears open (it takes about 5 seconds). Heard by everyone nearby, from the Rift itself.
signature.prompt: Solid rock slowly splitting open from the middle outward over five seconds: deep grinding and cracking stone and a rising low rumble, then a hollow rush of air being drawn inward like a held breath let go, with one faint low bell tone inside the rush. Ends with a few falling pebbles. Heavy, close, physical. No explosion, no scream, no music.

signature.name: The Hollow's ambience
signature.where: All the time while you are in the Hollow, quietly, under the Hollow's own thunder and the singing.
signature.prompt: Seamless looping ambience of a vast underground world with no sky: a very low, steady, airy drone like wind moving through an enormous cavern, slow distant water, an occasional faint glassy chime far away, and a barely audible wordless choir note that comes and goes. Calm, wide, lonely and slightly wrong, never frightening. No thunder, no footsteps, no creatures, no melody. Constant level, no sudden sounds.

signature.name: A storm tide of the endless siege
signature.where: In the Long Night, each time a fresh tide of soldiers comes by daylight ("Daylight. They come anyway.").
signature.prompt: A storm front arriving in daylight: a long roll of distant thunder that grows, a surge of wind, and underneath it the muffled sound of a great many feet marching closer and one far-off low war horn. Builds for ten seconds, then settles into steady wind. Ominous and tired rather than violent. No rain, no voices, no music.

signature.name: Morvane
signature.where: When Morvane rises from the Seat and the last fight begins.
signature.prompt: An old king rising slowly from a stone throne in an enormous silent hall: the scrape of heavy cloth on stone, one long weary exhale from a deep male voice, then a single very low bell tone that seems to come from inside the room and hangs in the air, with a faint high crystalline ringing above it. Sad, patient and immense, not monstrous. No words, no growl, no music.

signature.name: The Choir
signature.where: When the Choir turns toward you and seven voices begin to sing.
signature.prompt: Seven singers, men and women, entering one after another on the same low sustained note with no words, each voice very slightly out of tune with the last so the sound beats and shimmers. Cold stone-hall reverb. It swells to a full unison and then stops dead, all at once, mid-breath. Beautiful and unsettling. No melody, no instruments.

signature.name: The Clockwork Reeve
signature.where: When the Clockwork Reeve winds himself and his fight begins.
signature.prompt: A large brass clockwork mechanism being wound: slow heavy ratchet clicks, a spring tightening, gears engaging, then a tower-clock tick that stumbles and repeats the same tick three times as if stuck, and one dull clock chime cut short. Dry, metallic, precise. No music, no voices.

signature.name: The Pale Huntsman
signature.where: When the Pale Huntsman's fight begins (he is already watching you).
signature.prompt: A thin, pale hunting horn sounding once far away across a frozen forest, muffled by falling snow. Then silence, the creak of a bowstring being drawn very close by, and a single low wolf growl. Cold, still, patient. Light wind. No music, no voices, no howling pack.

signature.name: The Drowned Bride
signature.where: When the Drowned Bride rises with the tide.
signature.prompt: Something rising slowly out of deep still water: a long swell and pouring of water, the drip of heavy soaked fabric, a woman's soft wordless sigh, and two small chapel bells ringing underwater, muffled and bent out of tune. Mournful and slow, sad rather than scary. No scream, no music.

signature.name: The Ash Seneschal
signature.where: When the Ash Seneschal turns his blank face toward you.
signature.prompt: A heavy armoured knight turning to face you in a dry desert ruin: sand and ash hissing off metal plates, the slow grind of old armour joints, a huge iron shield set down on stone with one deep ringing thud, then a long hollow breath through an empty helmet. Dry, hot, weighty. No voice, no music.

signature.name: The Mother of Changelings
signature.where: When the Mother of Changelings smiles with someone else's face.
signature.prompt: A woman humming three slow notes of a lullaby, gentle and warm, in a quiet wet marsh at night. On the last note a second, identical voice joins a fraction too late and slightly off pitch. Soft frogs and dripping water far in the background, roots creaking. Tender and wrong. No words, no laughter, no music.

signature.name: The Warlord King
signature.where: When the Warlord King rides onto the field in the Grand Siege.
signature.prompt: A warlord arriving on a battlefield at night riding a huge beast: three very heavy, slow footfalls that shake the ground, the rattle of chains and armour, a deep animal snort, then a brutal brass war horn blast answered by a distant crowd of soldiers beating weapons on shields twice. Massive, confident, martial. No music, no words.

signature.name: The first glimpse
signature.where: Once per world, at 3:17 on the night something walks up between the soldiers that is not one of them.
signature.prompt: Night on a castle wall during a battle that suddenly goes quiet: the wind drops, the distant fighting fades to nothing, and in the silence come slow, even, unhurried footsteps on wet ground getting closer, with a very faint low choir note under them and one slow deep pulse like a heartbeat. It stops before anything happens. Quiet, tense, patient. No sting, no loud hit, no scream, no music.

signature.name: The Forgemaster's bell-tongue
signature.where: Morvane fight, stage 2: a Forgemaster's new bell rings once and the Standing Ranks break step.
signature.prompt: One clear, bright bronze hand-bell struck hard, close and present, with a pure ringing tone and a long shimmering tail that fills a stone hall. Under it, the clatter of many pieces of empty armour shifting at once, then stillness. No music, no voices. Ends in silence.

signature.name: The roll of the fallen
signature.where: At the Cinder Roost, when Kesh reads a name from the roll of the fallen, or a rider's dragon dies.
signature.prompt: A single low, muffled skin drum struck once in a high open cliffside space with dry desert wind, a soft boom that rolls away into the distance. Solemn, not dramatic. No melody, no voices. Ends in silence.

signature.name: The forty rowing
signature.where: Morvane fight, stage 4: the drowned crews of Holt's Debt row the party down the light river.
signature.prompt: Many oars dipping together in slow unison on dark still water inside a vast cavern, wooden oarlocks creaking in time, water dripping, and a low wordless hum from many tired voices keeping the stroke. Distant, hollow echo. Uneasy but steady. No music. Ends in silence.

signature.name: The fen collects
signature.where: When a Fen Mother's hexes all land at once, and at Morvane stage 6 when the fen lends the party a moment.
signature.prompt: A deep wet marsh sound: bubbles rising and bursting from thick mud, reeds rustling all at once as if a wind passed, and a slow low creak like an old wooden raft taking weight. A faint breathy whisper at the very end, no words. Uneasy, not frightening. Ends in silence.

dragons.name: Cinderwing: roar
dragons.prompt: The voice of a large fire-breathing dragon with a deep chest and a throat like a furnace: warm, rumbling, with a crackle of embers in the breath. A full roar: starts fast, peaks, and trails off into breath. Powerful and proud, not a monster-movie scream. One animal, close and dry, no echo, no background, no music.

dragons.name: Cinderwing: idle
dragons.prompt: The voice of a large fire-breathing dragon with a deep chest and a throat like a furnace: warm, rumbling, with a crackle of embers in the breath. A relaxed, low, closed-mouth grumble, the sound it makes when it is simply nearby and content. One animal, close and dry, no echo, no background, no music.

dragons.name: Cinderwing: hurt
dragons.prompt: The voice of a large fire-breathing dragon with a deep chest and a throat like a furnace: warm, rumbling, with a crackle of embers in the breath. A short sharp yelp of pain, cut off quickly. One animal, close and dry, no echo, no background, no music.

dragons.name: Cinderwing: purr

dragons.name: Cinderwing: snarl
dragons.prompt: The voice of a large fire-breathing dragon with a deep chest and a throat like a furnace: warm, rumbling, with a crackle of embers in the breath. A warning snarl through bared teeth, tight and rough, rising slightly. One animal, close and dry, no echo, no background, no music.

dragons.name: Cinderwing: whimper
dragons.prompt: The voice of a large fire-breathing dragon with a deep chest and a throat like a furnace: warm, rumbling, with a crackle of embers in the breath. A small, high, unhappy whimper, the sound of an animal that is hurt or afraid. One animal, close and dry, no echo, no background, no music.

dragons.name: Cinderwing: death
dragons.prompt: The voice of a large fire-breathing dragon with a deep chest and a throat like a furnace: warm, rumbling, with a crackle of embers in the breath. dragons.name: Dragon: flap

dragons.name: Dragon: fire
dragons.prompt: A dragon breathing a stream of fire: a roaring, rushing jet of flame with a low rumble underneath, steady for the whole clip. No voice, no background.

dragons.name: Dragon: breathe
dragons.prompt: A very large animal breathing in and out once while lying unconscious: slow, heavy, a little laboured. Close and quiet. No background.

dragons.name: Dragon: egg crack
dragons.prompt: A thick eggshell cracking: two or three sharp dry cracks and a small piece falling away. Close, no background.
